Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 2-K at 801-825 S Kilpatrick
                              Ave, 4607-4659 W Polk St and 4606-4658 W Arthington St -
                              App No. 22002
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                               ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2-K in the area bounded by


West Polk Street;


A line 550.61 feet east of and parallel to South Kilpatrick Avenue;


West Arthington Street;


And South Kilpatrick Street




to those of a M2-2 Light Industry District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.




Common Address of Property: 801-25 South Kilpatrick Street, 4607-59 West Polk Street, 4606-
58 West Arthington Street

9. Present Zoning District Ml-2           Proposed Zoning District     M2-2


10. Lot size in square feet (or dimensions)   146,594.4 sq. ft. (3.365 acres)
11. Current Use of the property Property contains an existing 60,000.0 sq. ft. warehouse where
low-impact manufacturing occurs.

12. Reason for rezoning the property To comply with zoning use standards in order to operate
light industry to accommodate moderate impact manufacturing, whole sales, warehousing,
and distribution uses including storage and work related activities that occur outside of our
enclosed building.

13. Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
Existing 60,000 sq. ft. building on site where manufacturing and distribution will occur involving
75-150 emplovees working three shifts. The new and existing building will require outside
storage for raw and completed goods and materials: no residential use, 68 on-site parkmg spaces.
The existing building's height is 37 feet.

14. The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
and/or afinancialcontribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive
a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing
Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?
